name: DE LAROSIÈRE, Jacques Martin Henri Marie

roles.title: President
roles.organisation: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

details.imageSource: De Larosière at the IMF, n.d., Flickr
details.summary: French civil servant and sixth Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) 1978-1987 and second President of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) 1993-1998
details.life: Was born 12 November 1929 in Paris, France. He is the son of Robert Louis Marie de Larosière, captain in the French Navy, and Hugayte de Champfeu. In 1960 he married France du Bos. They have one daughter and one son.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
